source.title: How to Fix Sticking or Squeaking Buttons on the PlayStation 1

steps.title: Confirm sticking Power and Open buttons
steps.visible_check: Power button sticks down and Open button squeaks or hesitates when pressed
steps.warning: Unplug power and remove disc and cables before handling

steps.title: Remove bottom screws and separate shell
steps.visible_check: Six bottom screws out and top lid assembly lifted free from bottom chassis
steps.warning: Do not pry aggressively; keep screws together so none are lost

steps.title: Isolate top cover and remove Power button cap
steps.visible_check: Underside of top cover exposed and round Power cap popped free by pressing clips
steps.warning: Press clips gently to avoid snapping plastic tabs

steps.title: Inspect Power button and apply silicone grease
steps.visible_check: Thin clear grease film only on side rub tabs and center spring post, excess wiped away
steps.warning: Use only plastic-safe silicone grease in a very thin layer; keep grease off outer face

steps.title: Reinstall spring and Power button cap
steps.visible_check: Spring seated on center post and button clicks in facing correct direction with free return
steps.warning: Verify orientation before snapping in; spring can pop out and get lost

steps.title: Remove Open slider assembly
steps.visible_check: Two screws out and rectangular slider block lifted away to reveal Open button post
steps.warning: Hold assembly while unscrewing; note spring position before lifting

steps.title: Lubricate Open slider wear surfaces
steps.visible_check: All plastic-on-plastic slide and contact edges show thin even grease sheen
steps.warning: Do not flood with grease; thin layer only where plastics rub

steps.title: Lubricate and reinstall Open button cap
steps.visible_check: Open cap tabs and housing slide slots lightly greased and cap snapped in freely moving
steps.warning: This button has no separate spring; do not stretch or lose slider spring

steps.title: Reinstall slider assembly and secure screws
steps.visible_check: Slider seated in guides, spring hooked, and both screws snug with assembly sliding smoothly
steps.warning: Seat screws counterclockwise to click first to avoid cross-threading; hold assembly down while driving screws

steps.title: Test buttons and reassemble console
steps.visible_check: Power and Open press quietly, return crisply, and lid opens without sticking
steps.warning: Test before fully tightening case; keep fingers clear of lid spring
